blind.description: An ornate architectural corbel or wall bracket designed to mount to a vertical wall. It features a flat rectangular top shelf, a flat mounting back, and a decorated front face framed with side volutes/scrollwork. The face features a raised gold relief depicting the scales of justice above three circular coins, set against an inlaid dark green enameled ground. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with clean geometry and no detached or broken elements.
